items.summary: Indian equity markets rallied over 1.5% on Tuesday, with the Sensex rising 1,109 points and the Nifty 50 gaining 358 points. IT stocks led the advance, with HCL Tech and TCS topping the gainers’ lists. Kotak Mahindra Bank, Eternal and Maruti Suzuki were among the notable laggards.
